question: The ________ was abruptly called off by Mahatma Gandhi due to the Chauri Chaura incident.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Non-cooperation Movement**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Non-cooperation Movement was launched by Mahatma Gandhi in 1920.
 
• It aimed at resisting British rule in India through non-violent means or "Ahimsa".
 
• The movement was called off by Gandhi in February 1922 after the Chauri Chaura incident, where a violent mob set fire to a police station, killing 22 policemen.
 
• Gandhi believed that the movement had deviated from its non-violent path and needed to be paused to prevent further violence.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chauri Chaura Incident:**

 
 
• The Chauri Chaura incident occurred on February 4, 1922, in the Gorakhpur district of the United Provinces (modern-day Uttar Pradesh).
 
• During a protest against the British authorities, a group of non-cooperation movement supporters clashed with the police.
 
• The protesters set fire to the Chauri Chaura police station, resulting in the death of 22 policemen.
 
• This violent act prompted Gandhi to call off the Non-cooperation Movement, emphasizing that the movement must remain non-violent.
 
 
 
• **Kheda Movement:**
 
 
• Launched in 1918, the Kheda Movement was a peasant revolt against the British in the Kheda district of Gujarat.
 
• Farmers were demanding the suspension of revenue collection due to crop failure.
 
• It was led by Mahatma Gandhi, who helped the peasants in their civil disobedience struggle.
 
 
 
• **Rowlatt Act Satyagraha:**
 
 
• In 1919, the Rowlatt Act was passed, which allowed the British government to imprison any person suspected of terrorism without trial.
 
• Gandhi initiated a nationwide satyagraha against this act, which marked the beginning of widespread protests and hartals.
 
 
 
• **Champaran Satyagraha:**
 
 
• The Champaran Satyagraha of 1917 was the first satyagraha movement led by Gandhi in India.
 
• It was a farmer's uprising that took place in the Champaran district of Bihar, protesting against the oppressive policies of the British indigo planters.
